capabilities.mechanism: Admit the strict externally pinned selected handoff; invoke one explicit no-tool planning callback, preserve exact inputs/failures and replay; validate many-to-many question/evidence/design/analysis/result links, retain unknowns and require separate bound semantic review and human plan decision. Offline workflow commands attach existing evidence to immutable externally pinned checkpoints, reconstruct status on resume and prepare unrun paired slots without dispatch. Offline evaluation prepare/record commands separately bind the generic guidance, frozen P7-P9 catalog, saved plan/intake and supplied raw judgment; preserve per-SQ evidence and scored/unverifiable/grader_error states without dispatch or readiness promotion.

capabilities.native_text_subject_contract: Opt-in offline prepare/inspect/record admits the existing Stage2 selection and original SQ context independently of any B plan, binds unchanged UTF8 bytes/raw hash and mechanically reversible line locators, and never extracts or fills scientific design. Inspect reconstructs source/current raw text; supplied judgments retain separate P7/P8/P9 states and canonical line evidence. Native identity, actual research/receiver acceptance, calibration, pairing and improvement remain unverified; authority flags false. Structured jobs/campaign masking explicitly refuse this raw type before dispatch or rewriting.
capabilities.evaluation_job_contract: Reuse the existing host job journal and P7/P8/P9 request/record validators for one explicitly configured R1/R2/ADJ adapter call; preserve raw judgments, prose/streams, actual exit or unknown, grader_error/unverifiable vectors and failed/partial captures. Canonical read-only replay reuses the completed Delivery A2 evaluator module bytes. Optional campaign recording/index attachment requires the pinned Delivery A implementation; missing dependency rejects before dispatch. No automatic judging, retries, authenticated identity, formal pairing or scientific improvement is established.
capabilities.planning_job_contract: Wrap the existing host Journal and strict selected workflow for one explicitly dispatched planning callback; bind project/index/workflow/current source/all SQ/schema/runtime/context and preserve saved or failed outcomes. Inspect and replay never dispatch. Partial/uncertain attempts remain execution-unknown until explicit saved-artifact reconciliation. NativePlanner owns actual deadlines and zero retries; no session/process manager, readiness gate or research authority is added. Synthetic job tests mock admission and do not establish live isolation or scientific validity.
capabilities.direction_intent_contract: Consume the externally pinned Stage2DirectionPlanningIntent and verified advisory package without generation or Host dispatch. Retain preferred current versions, original SQs, assessments, evidence, resources and unknowns. Keep selected_options empty, human_selection pending, formal_selected_receiver false and execution_authorized false. Reversible value sharing preserves exact source values and their hash within the existing prompt bound; missing SQ mapping or an oversized context cannot prepare a prompt. Formal selection, conditional job execution and scientific acceptance remain separate. A typed DirectionPlanningJobs subclass now reuses the existing journal, single explicit dispatch, failure capture, inspection and recovery; a separate conditional result must cover every original question_ref exactly once and cannot attach a formal selected plan or evaluation subject. Conditional jobs bound the complete serialized request before recording an intent, bind the complete CLI producer source tree on preparation and every inspection or recovery, and recover an interrupted sealed result without another callback.
capabilities.legacy_mapping_contract: Explicit v1 packet/source-byte checked read-only question mapping retains manual origin, current versions, full original history, unknown resource status and missing review/human-choice blockers. It is not a strict delivery or a generation admission. Optional mapping enrichment still requires strict current delivery/interaction admission, exact logical packet equivalence, selected-version closure and trusted-host verification of the displayed mapping choice; no CLI override or fabricated old review. Bounded source capture precedes semantic validation; selected original approaches/limitations and packet unresolved context survive into hashed planning requests independently of decision conditions.
capabilities.condition_resolution_contract: Opt-in plan1.1 preserves default1.0 schema bytes; source-bound condition dispositions and evidence/deadline/owner/trigger/fallback unknown records add deterministic diagnostics without changing strict admission, human verification or conservative resource blocking. Assumption/deferred metadata never resolves evidence or authorizes execution.
capabilities.verified_input_origin_contract: Only after shared strict admission, deepcopy optional input_origin into the planning intake. Keep native/legacy absent origin absent, preserve typed project version and not-established human identity, and retain execution false. Projection alone is not admission; external pin or rehashed origin/choice tampering rejects through the public receiver.

capability_extensions.project_stage3_planning_contract: Programmatic trusted ProjectHost wiring reuses the same selected-project intake, existing PlanningJobs Journal and configured adapter. Prepare/read/inspect/recover never dispatch; an explicit confirmed HTTP run acknowledges admission separately and continues once in its existing request thread under the original native deadline. Current typed versions, selection receipt, external package hashes, all questions, conditions and unknowns are reverified. Browser fields cannot set paths, configuration, credentials or recovery pins. The original no-retry job semantics and five false authority flags remain unchanged; no worker, scheduler or chat wake adapter is created. JSON envelopes must be objects. Real research-package acceptance and native/scientific validation remain separate from the optional CLI composition.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_direction_planning_contra: A saved current direction preference enters the existing planning API with mode=direction-intent and the original intent hash/key. The Host rechecks principal, project frontier, immutable source pins and adapter context before dispatch and publication. Passive reads, save-only, prepare, inspect and recover make no planner call. Missing question mappings or oversized prompts retain the saved preference and return needs-information with visible blockers and no default_request. A complete identical pre-journal input may be reused; a mismatched or partial input is preserved and refused. The conditional view retains original questions, material mappings and the separate saved result for the Wiki presentation slice. Saved-job reuse rechecks the current model/adapter/source binding, and recovery availability uses the existing trusted pin map. Existing capture isolation, HTTP request thread and deadlines are reused. Each immutable project, reference and direction-intent hash gets a distinct capture inside the prevalidated direction namespace; same-intent replay retains its original capture and does not dispatch again. planning_target is stage3-planning-job; agent_conversation_connected and all authority flags stay false. Authored callback/DOM evidence does not establish deployed, native or scientific acceptance.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_planning_configuration_co: Closed externally hashed server-owned settings are validated before opening any Journal or listener. The factory composes the existing selected-project service, one original Journal with separate project owners, existing PlanningJobs and lazy NativePlanner. Real authenticated intake reference/internal-id/root form a Host journal identity token, never a native ProjectIndex or approval. Output paths and capture slots cannot overlap, trusted recovery pins stay server-only, and constructor cleanup preserves the primary failure and cleanup errors. Loading and factory construction dispatch zero calls. CLI activation, deployed lifecycle, real material availability, human selection and scientific improvement require separate acceptance; five authority flags remain false.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_cli_activation_contract: Opt-in closed externally hashed CLI settings compose the existing selected-project service, one original Journal and PlanningJobs owners, and original NativePlanner. Loading settings and starting the listener never dispatch. Real intake reference/internal-id/root form an explicit Host journal identity token, never a native ProjectIndex or approval. Native capture slots are explicit and no new key retries an attempted capture; trusted recovery pins remain server-only. Configured CLI request threads use the existing non-daemon ThreadingMixIn join. Only the CLI closes its factory Journal and intake after every original handler has drained, including non-run requests; an unconfirmed join leaves both open and reports the failure. The original native deadline and HTTP cap remain unchanged. Constructor/cleanup failures remain visible, and five authority flags remain false. Deterministic fixture tests do not establish real material availability, human selection or scientific improvement.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_existing_store_startup_co: Explicit existing-stage23-store mode retains source/hash/private/no-link checks, requires an existing intake database with bounded SQLite sidecar paths, forbids native Stage1/model/query/source registration and reuses only already matching direct imports. Default native Windows path reservations remain unchanged. This is startup compatibility, not a general proof of future output path lengths or research acceptance.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_wiki_contract: Reuse the existing planning page for source-bound per-SQ resources, designs, analyses, result interpretations, shared designs, unknown evidence/deadlines/fallbacks and milestones. Conditional direction mode keeps original source questions and resource mappings separate from generated advice and user/source unknowns. Plain labels distinguish a preferred version and conditional draft from formal selection; common resource values are shown as labeled fields and nested recorded details remain expandable. Recorded next-check text is readable, with original source markers and other fields available in expandable details. All original values and raw receipts are retained. English, Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese use inert textContent and no inferred scientific design. The entry prioritizes original context, recorded progress and an applicable next action; running/saved jobs hide start controls, saved needs-information remains explicit, and version/authority receipts are expandable. An accepted explicit run reads the actual job without another dispatch. Verified current job outcomes outrank retained connection errors, and an error affects controls only when its key/request hash matches; all historical errors remain in raw receipts. Loading, failures and unknown outcomes offer read/inspect guidance; responsive layout and keyboard focus are presentation checks only. When an explicit action hides its control, same-project focus moves to confirmation, draft review or saved-state reading. The canonical HTML URL carries encoded project and allowlisted language in its client-only fragment, without storage or a Host route change. Unknown or malformed projects select none; explicit locale/project changes replace the permalink, and review buttons scroll/focus without destroying it. Passive render, language changes and stale-project protection dispatch nothing; explicit actions keep the existing typed request/key and authority boundaries. A read-only Wiki diagram draws only explicit saved question, design, analysis, result and conditional references; missing links and source unknowns remain visible. The Wiki mounts the same version-bound selection component with scoped DOM; pending or uncertain submissions retain their original key, and preference remains distinct from formal selection. This presentation does not establish semantic sufficiency, human confirmation, actual receiver acceptance, calibration or A/B improvement.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_oneclick_contract: An explicit save-and-start selection click reuses the original selection key and existing APIs. Saved transaction status and fresh same-selection acknowledgements precede server-derived prepare, matching prepared request and one confirmed run. Save-only and passive reads never plan; stale projects/versions, existing jobs, unknown/failed receipts and response loss never automatically retry. HTTP202 is admission, not completion. Existing source/eligibility/authority guards and five false flags remain unchanged; deterministic DOM responses are synthetic, not real selected receiver or scientific evidence.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_read_verification_contrac: Only one locked synchronous planning GET may reuse a successful strict selection verification for the same intake, authenticated principal, project, bindings and verifier implementations. Every new request, mutation and dispatch retains fresh source/frontier/version admission; failed reads, changed bindings, copied contexts in other threads and closed scopes cannot reuse. Saved direction refresh inspects the authenticated original job once and never dispatches. This reduces redundant verification only; HTTP and native deadlines, source guards and authority flags are unchanged.
capability_extensions.project_stage3_wiki_navigation_contract: After a validated accepted selection or an explicit continuation, allowlisted same-project Wiki navigation reloads the existing authenticated bootstrap so the committed revision and Stage3 route are read together. The original pending marker, selection/planning key and authority flags remain; reload does not resubmit or dispatch. Wrong project, language, stale version and suspended stage cannot navigate. This fixes a hash-only transition, not human selection or scientific acceptance.
capability_extensions.wiki_readability_contract: Saved conditional planning projects the existing question and seven scalar fields into eight ordered, initially collapsed source steps. This is navigation through a proposed plan, not inferred scientific links or completed execution. Explicit resource uses match the original candidate version and question; unknown availability and proposed fit stay unchanged, while unmapped material leads remain in the complete source text. Formal linked-record plans retain the existing graph. The saved preference receipt is separate from a fresh editing draft; passive rendering does not preselect or submit. Sidebar stages 1-6 preserve the canonical project/language permalink; later-stage preview labels do not grant execution.
